title: Respiratory Mechanics and Pleural Effusion
brief_summary: The investigators aim to compare the respiratory mechanics in acute lung injury (ALI)/acute respiratory diseases syndrome (ARDS) patients with and without pleural effusion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ALI/ARDS patients underwent invasive mechanical ventilation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Haemodynamic instability
* Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) patients
